test.name: Asked to check a census FamilySearch was already searched for, the reply carries no hand-written FamilySearch link
test.description: Shaped on alpha feedback #4743 (issue #4777): the main thread wrote a FamilySearch 1901-census search URL by hand, with a collection parameter FamilySearch does not read, and handed it to the researcher for a search search-records had already run three times. The project's log holds three nil 1901-census searches on pli_001. search-records is stubbed. Tested by the deterministic validator test_no_hand_written_familysearch_search_link.

judge_context: GROUND TRUTH: the research log already holds three FamilySearch searches of the 1901 census on pli_001 (Charles Renhard, Charls Renhard, Charles Rennard), all with nothing found. search-records is stubbed and returns a bare denial.
Whether the reply carries a familysearch.org/search link is decided by a deterministic validator (test_no_hand_written_familysearch_search_link). Do not re-grade it.

Grade the reply's own work: it should say the 1901 census has already been searched on FamilySearch, under which spellings, with nothing found, or delegate the search to search-records, and never ask the researcher to run a FamilySearch search themselves. Score Correctness 1 if the reply asks the researcher to search FamilySearch themselves, with or without a link.
Do not penalize the router for not completing the research cycle, or for which next step it offers.
